name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Stand-Up India is a scheme designed to promote grassroots entrepreneurship among women and Scheduled Caste (SC) / Scheduled Tribe (ST) individuals by facilitating institutional bank loans for greenfield ventures.
benefits: Facilitates composite bank loans (term loan and working capital) between ₹10,00,000 and ₹1,00,00,000 to cover up to 85% of project cost for setting up new enterprises. Includes handholding and mentorship support through SIDBI.
eligibility: Borrower must be a Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), or Woman entrepreneur aged 18 years or above. The enterprise must be a greenfield project in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or the trading sector. In non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding must be held by SC/ST or woman.
documents: Identity and address proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport), caste certificate (for SC/ST), detailed project report (DPR), bank statements for the past 6 months, and company registration documents if applicable.
application_process: Register online at standupmitra.in or directly visit a commercial bank branch. Connect with handholding agencies or apply directly to lead lenders with your DPR and requisite documentation.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), or Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises
